latin: Cum dicit Anstoteles non recordari nos post mortem quia passiuus intellectus corrumpitur, per passiuum intellectum, possibilem intellectum intelligit.
translation: When Aristotle says that we do not remember after death because the passive intellect is corrupted, by 'passive intellect' he means the possible intellect.
